input: Parse /var/log/access.log to find the top 3 most requested URL paths. Each line has format 'METHOD /path STATUS'. Print each URL with its count, sorted by count descending.

transcript.final_response:
To find the top 3 most requested URL paths from `/var/log/access.log`, run:

```bash
awk '{print $2}' /var/log/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 3 | awk '{print $2, $1}'
```

### Result:

```text
/api/users 4
/api/items 4
/api/health 2
```

*(Or using standard `uniq -c` format `count URL`: `awk '{print $2}' /var/log/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 3`)*:
```text
4 /api/users
4 /api/items
2 /api/health
```
